en.headline: Chris Tang says Huanggang Port drills will involve up to 20,000 people
en.dek: The Security Bureau chief said progressive exercises starting next week will test traffic and passenger flows well above previous peak-hour levels before any decision on formal opening.
body: Secretary for Security Chris Tang Ping-keung said on Friday that the redeveloped Huanggang Port will undergo a series of drills, culminating in an exercise involving as many as 20,000 participants, before the government decides on a formal opening date.

Speaking after the Hong Kong-side control point had been under local jurisdiction for a week, Tang said a 1,000-person traffic test is scheduled for 13 August, to be followed by larger exercises of 5,000 and then up to 20,000 people. The largest drill is intended to exceed the previous peak hourly throughput of about 7,700 passengers by more than double.

More than 100 exercises covering roughly 20 categories — including systems, traffic flow, emergency response and joint operations with Shenzhen authorities — are planned. Only after the tests demonstrate orderly and safe operations will the two sides discuss an opening timetable.

Tang emphasised that the government would review the results carefully and would not open the port until both the public and operators are confident that the new co-location and one-stop vehicle clearance arrangements can function smoothly.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強：皇崗口岸演練將涉最多兩萬人
zh.dek: 保安局局長表示下星期起將進行遞增規模演練，最大一場涉及約兩萬人，遠超以往高峰人流後才決定正式開通日期。
body: 保安局局長鄧炳強周五表示，重建後的皇崗口岸港方口岸區接管一星期以來，當局正籌備一系列演練，最大規模將動員約兩萬人，確保運作暢順後才與深圳方面商討正式開通日期。
鄧炳強指，本月13日將先進行1,000人的交通測試，其後逐步增至5,000人，以至約兩萬人的大型演練。最大一場演練的人流將比以往高峰每小時約7,700人次多出一倍以上。
當局計劃進行超過100場涵蓋約20個類別的測試，包括系統、交通流量、應急及與深方聯合演練等。只有所有測試證明有序及安全，雙方才會討論開通時間表。
鄧炳強強調，政府會認真檢視成效，待市民及營運單位都有信心新「合作查驗、一次放行」及「聯合一站式」車道安排可暢順運作後，才會正式開通口岸。
